approaches_tried.approach: Running the source-store copy of test-validate-state.sh directly to iterate on Fixture (g)
approaches_tried.reason: Fixture (g) resolves REPO_ROOT via 'git rev-parse --show-toplevel' from the test's own SCRIPT_DIR (the suite's pre-existing, documented design, supporting running from either the source-store or deployed location). Run from the source store, this resolves to the agent-system config repo itself (a separate git repo), so Fixture (g) exercised THAT repo's own stale self-hosted deploy rather than BimodalLogic's. Resolved by re-deploying into BimodalLogic and re-running the DEPLOYED copy via run-all.sh, which is also exactly what the plan's own Phase 4 verification criteria call for ('re-deployed and re-run against the deployed copies'). Confirmed: test-validate-state.sh PASSES in full (72/72) against the deployed copy.

approaches_tried.approach: Plan's trap-case fixture wording for test-validate-state.sh ("must PASS, with the reported next free value being the dense one") read literally
approaches_tried.result: ambiguous, resolved by implementing both readings
approaches_tried.reason: Check 12 has no 'reported next free value' field on its PASS path (only the FAIL path's repair hint reports a correct/next-free value) -- a literal PASS-only fixture could not exercise the 'reported value' clause at all. Implemented Fixture (h) as two parts: (h-i) a dense counter (847) above a high active max (846) PASSes despite much lower free numbers also existing; (h-ii) the identical shape with the counter colliding with the high in-use number instead FAILs, with its repair value confirmed to be the dense 847, never a recycled low gap. Both readings of the plan's sentence are now covered.

deviations.description: add a fixture for the trap at the validator layer
deviations.reason: Plan named a single PASS-outcome fixture; implemented as two sub-fixtures (h-i, h-ii) since Check 12 only surfaces a reportable next-free value on its FAIL path -- see approaches_tried above for the full reasoning.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — split into two sub-fixtures to cover both the PASS-outcome and reported-value halves of the plan's sentence)*
